answer: A newcomer enters a spiral staircase in the orchard: first payout capped at $0.10, full pay after ten verified rungs, each rung one finished job signed by its payer, posted publicly. A random auditor from the nebula panel picks one rung within four hours and demands the receipt. A missing receipt, forged signature, or skipped rung freezes the climb, voids the payout, and locks it out for a week. One honest worker climbs one rung per real job; a farmer with 1,000 fakes must finish 10,000 real jobs for full pay, risking 1,000 frozen accounts.
